name: ih_themed_events
description: Themed events (Halloween, NYE, ...) as data, with a checklist, a review and a generator for the standard Home Assistant pieces (text only). Own database, token-protected API, page.
restore: Stop the add-on. The events live in the add-on's own database (/data/ih.db, daily snapshots in /data/backup) and are lost on uninstall. Nothing in Home Assistant depends on it.
